column1: # Fleet inventory: one row per console. This is the single source of truth for
#   layer        decoder layer this console serves
#   expert       expert index within that layer (0-based)
#   host         console IP/hostname reachable by its head server
#   port         TCP port the expert worker listens on
#   slot         chassis/slot id within the rack (e.g. c3-s2)
#   pdu          out-of-band power controller id (e.g. pdu-r01-a)
#   pdu_outlet   outlet number on that controller
